name: SQLite WAL checkpoint concurrency and ledger-consistency stress

concurrent_roles: 8 writer threads, one transaction per obligation
runs: 20,000 writes / 5,000 checkpoint attempts / 6,000 snapshots, repeated twice

acceptance_gates: all requested writes accepted in this unlimited-cap workload
used_units equals sum of unique canonical obligation amounts
all read snapshots observe counter equals obligation sum
held-reader TRUNCATE checkpoint is explicitly reported busy/partial until reader release
claim_ceiling: Application-level SQLite WAL checkpoint/read/write stress on one host only. Does not reproduce the SQLite internal WAL-reset bug, prove fixed-version safety, simulate kernel or power failure, or qualify Rust/Holochain/multi-host production paths.
engine_gate: Runtime SQLite 3.46.1 is within the range affected by the documented WAL-reset bug. Repeat on SQLite 3.53.3 (latest official release observed 2026-10-28), or at minimum 3.51.3 / verified vendor backport, and use the dedicated low-level regression approach; generic stress is not the bug reproducer.
